rebecca (People Ops): FYI Emma submitted resignation today; last day 2026-04-02. Need access deprovision plan, final pay/COBRA, equipment return (EU), license transfers, and 30-60m exit interview. :wave:
emma.li: Confirmed. Happy to do KT. Requesting business-only forwarding for 90 days to teamruntime@ to preserve client threads — allowed?
nick (Eng): Please list repos/service accounts and any long-lived tokens. We'll rotate as needed.
rebecca (People Ops): Nick please post by EOD. IT, open return ticket for Amsterdam shipping.
it-support-bot: Ticket IT-6821 opened for EU laptop return. Shipping label option; carrier pickup earliest 2026-04-03.
payroll-bot: Final paycheck processed on last day (2026-04-02). Submit expenses by 2026-03-29. COBRA notice emailed within 7 business days of termination; 60-day enrollment window.
olivia (Security): Forwarding okay for business emails only; exclude HR/payroll and any PII. Need signed acknowledgement and SSO disable after 90 days. We'll audit PII access before enabling.
emma.li: I will sign. I don't need Figma after my last day — release that seat. For JetBrains, will submit receipts for reimbursement. I'll add OWNERS and a short KT in infra/README/offboard-emma.md
nick (Eng): Quick owners: infra/kv-cache, runtime/kernels, tools/deploy. Will rotate deploy-batch-token-2019 and revoke admin incident token on 2026-04-02 (keep read-only DB until 2026-05-01).
sam (Recruiting): Opening backfill req for Staff ML Engineer and scheduling 4h overlap pairing in final week.
mike (Facilities): Use https://internal.redwood/it/returns to submit EU shipping info. Pickup can be scheduled 2026-04-03.
rebecca (People Ops): Action items: 1) Nick: service-account + token rotation plan (due 2026-03-27). 2) IT: ship/collect laptop + set forwarding rule (pending Security). 3) Security: post acknowledgement template + audit (Olivia). 4) Payroll: final pay + COBRA notice. 5) Recruiting: open req + schedule handoff. 6) Emma: KT doc + OWNERS PR + license receipts. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
olivia (Security): Posting acknowledgement template now and looping Legal.
it-support-bot: Suggested deprovision command (do not run until approved): `./scripts/deprovision --user emma.li --revoke-admin --schedule 2026-04-02 --keep-readonly-until 2026-05-01`
rebecca (People Ops): We'll wait for signed form and KT before running deprovision. I'll publish a final offboarding checklist with dates by EOD.
